Meta.title: AutoExplore
Meta.author: Yuof
Meta.description:
[h1]AutoExplore Mod[/h1]
[b]Press [i]L[/i] to automatically explore the current map.[/b]
This mod includes the following features: [list] [*][b]Auto-fight[/b] [*][b]Auto-trap handling[/b] [*][b]Auto-loot collection[/b] [*][b]Auto-harvesting[/b] [*][b]Auto-mining[/b] [/list]
[h2]Controls[/h2] [list] [*]Press [i]L + LeftShift[/i] to toggle between modes: [olist] [*]Explore [*]Gather [*]Mine [*]Combined [/olist] [*]Keybinds available for moving up or down stairs. [/list]
[h2]Priority System[/h2] [i]Tasks are completed in the following order:[/i] [olist] [*]Fight visible enemies [*]Disarm visible traps [*]Explore and loot [/olist]
[h2]Configuration[/h2] Config file: [code]Elin\BepInEx\config\yuof.elin.autoExplore.mod.cfg[/code] Customizable settings include: [list] [*]Enable/disable fighting [*]Enable/disable trap handling [*]Enable/disable meditating [*]Enable/disable harvesting [*]Enable/disable mining [*]Set meditation thresholds [*]Set stamina thresholds [*]Customize keybinds [/list]
[h2]Tips[/h2] [list] [*]Set up your in-game auto-fight settings (found in the last tab of the character window). [*]Adjust the auto-stop setting to avoid running past enemies ([i]check screenshot for guidance[/i]). [*]Equip appropriate tools such as an axe or pickaxe for harvesting and mining. [/list]
[h2]Notes[/h2] [list] [*]The mod won't explore unreachable rooms. [*]If you are too tired to meditate, the mod will use a carried bed to prevent falling asleep. [*]I am looking for ways to add an in-game way to exclude specific items/objects from being gathered. Figuring out a how to do UI is not easy. [/list]
